flows.title: Create a deal for a contact
steps: Go to the details page of the contact.
Click the Add deal button. You can also create a deal from the Deals section under Contact information.
Add other contacts related to the deal in the Related contacts section.
Choose the Related account for the deal, if there is one.
Choose the deal type and give the deal a name in Deal Name. Freshsales suggests a name based on the account name and the deal type.
Add products to the deal and select the Deal stage from the drop-down.
Fill in any other required field the form shows, then click Save.
Find the new deal on the Deals list view page, and click it to see the Deal summary page.

flows.title: Find contacts with a view of your own
steps: Open the Contacts module and choose one of the tabs to see a refined list of contacts.
To make a view of your own, go to Contacts, click + beside the tabs and choose Add new view.
Click Filter by to open the filter overlay, and add the filters you need.
Sort the contacts by when they were Created, Updated or Last contacted.
Keep the search criteria as a custom view, so the same list does not have to be built again.

flows.title: Review a contact's details
steps: In the Contacts module, click a contact to open the contact's details page.

Read the page: the contact's picture, deals with their lifecycle stage, score, recent conversations and recent activities, and details such as Phone number, Email, Source, Time zone, Owner and Location.
Click Edit (View and edit all fields) to see all of the contact's information.
Click the notes, tasks or appointments icon to view each of those for the contact.
